acceptance_criteria: Design document at src/design/expr-benchmark.md exists and is complete
Benchmark methodology clearly specified for 5-10 node AST expressions
Performance targets and measurement approach documented
Design validates feasibility and provides implementation roadmap for BACKEND-DEV
task.description: Design benchmark suite for expression evaluation performance (DSL-13). Create design artifact at src/design/expr-benchmark.md specifying: benchmark methodology, measurement approach, test expression profiles (simple to complex), expected performance targets against 10 microsecond goal, metrics collection strategy.

context.notes: SHOULD requirement: Design benchmark suite for expression evaluation performance. Typical expression (5-10 AST nodes) SHOULD evaluate in <10 microseconds on commodity hardware.

result.summary: Benchmark suite design completed: 6 test profiles from trivial to complex (1-10 AST nodes), methodology for wall-clock latency measurement, success criteria (mean <10µs), metrics collection strategy (min/max/p50/p95/p99), implementation roadmap for BACKEND-DEV
